newsitem.title: USA: Fox TV - Garzarelli says US stock market overvalued.
newsitem.headline: Fox TV - Garzarelli says US stock market overvalued.

text.p: Stock market analyst Elaine Garzarelli, president of Garzarelli Capital, said in an interview Monday on Fox TV that she views the stock market as fully valued and by some measures overvalued.
Garzarelli, who is credited with predicting the 1987 stock market crash, said the market could be in for another correction -- "I think maybe 15 to 25 percent, based on my valuation work."

Garzarelli said price earning ratios (PEs) are about 17-1/2 times this year's earnings and 19-1/2 times next year's earnings. "They should be at 16 times based on interest rates. So the valuation is telling me we're 10 to 15 percent overvalued on a PE basis," she said. "On a cash flow basis, which is earnings plus deferred taxes plus depreciation, we're 15 to 25 percent overvalued."
Comparing dividend yields for the S&P 500s with 10-year bond yields, Garzarelli said "we're 25 percent overvalued."
